direction: Light field atlas: paper ground, dark blue-green ink, teal logs, coral current records, ochre metadata; Source Sans 3 with dedicated connection corridors.
thesis: Kafka separates ordered partition logs, replica durability, independent consumer progress and cluster metadata consensus.
model: Independent standard consumer groups and offsets
visible_evidence: Broker-by-partition matrix exposes replica placement and leadership
One expanded partition shows replication without crossing other partitions
Two groups align independent cursors against the same retained log
Metadata voters are separate from record storage and consumer offsets
reading_order: Partition placement, replication detail, consumer progress, metadata quorum.
production_contract: Editable vector scene generated by scripts/gallery/kafka.js. Semantic relationships are encoded through aligned logs, containment and short labelled data paths.
scope: Illustrative Apache Kafka 4.3 cluster with three brokers, three dedicated controllers, three partitions and replication factor three. Standard consumer groups; share groups, transactions, Connect, Streams and deployment networking omitted. Offsets and replica snapshots are synthetic.
